description: tree-sitter grammar.js for an expression-and-let language with precedence rules for operators, number and identifier patterns.

steps.description: Module exports: grammar with name mylang and rules object.
Source structure: source_file is repeat of _statement, which is choice of let_stmt or print_stmt.
Statements: let_stmt parses 'let' identifier '=' expr ';', print_stmt parses 'print' expr ';'.
Expressions: _expr chooses number, identifier, or binary; binary has precedence with left associativity for + and *.
Terminals: number matches digits, identifier matches word characters.

title: Minimal tree-sitter Grammar
